basic_info.description: Iconic Castro first home or pied-a-terre. Two primary bedrooms and one flex room with a closet and window for an office or nursery. Chic and newly-remodeled split bathroom and kitchen. The tranquil and sophisticated living room with wood paneling is a beautiful spot for entertaining, leading out into a formal, but contemporary dining room and open plan modern kitchen. Large windows everywhere lend this serene property tons of natural light and look out onto the huge shared backyard. August Lock on front door for mobile entry and remote access. This home is stylish and spacious, yet warm and comfortable. There is a large easy in-and-out garage space a half block away with FOUR guest parking spots that can be occupied for up to 36 hours. Tons of storage space downstairs. It doesn't get more central, convenient, and inviting than this.
